title: My Place
teaser: When a single quarterly scrub-mentorship slot forces an unavoidable choice between Moe Honjo and Anji Tonegawa on the eve of Aoi Tohsaka's complex open biliary reconstruction, Ryuji Sakaguchi and Artoria Pendragon share both the decision and the weight left behind—leading Artoria to a quiet realization about her own place.
gallery_caption: Pausing outside the illuminated fourth-floor observation window after Aoi Tohsaka's Hepp-Couinaud hepaticojejunostomy and Anji Tonegawa's candid debrief, Artoria Pendragon watches the team they built stand together and imagines trusting herself to that table.

speakers.杉村弘子 ＆ 本庄萌恵 ＆ 利根川安琪: Hiroko Sugimura & Moe Honjo & Anji Tonegawa

choices.choice_ar5_c1_a: "I'll open by laying out the role criteria in full. If Anji feels unreconciled and wants to press for answers, I'll catch every question myself."
choices.choice_ar5_c1_b: "Let's state the reasons behind our choice plainly today—then once tomorrow's operation is safely done, we'll put Anji's next-step training plan in place."
choices.choice_ar5_c1_c: "Right. Both today's candid explanation and our ongoing commitment to the one not chosen after the operation—we carry all of it together."
choices.choice_ar5_c2_a: "The transverse segment of the left hepatic duct runs clean and its anterior wall is free of scar traction—how about spatulating longitudinally to the left to widen it?"
choices.choice_ar5_c2_b: "I have the right hepatic artery and portal bifurcation shielded behind my retractor, so you can reshape toward the left hepatic duct with confidence."
choices.choice_ar5_c3_a: "If the Deputy Chief actually lay down on that table, Moe and Anji wouldn't sleep a wink for three days beforehand."
choices.choice_ar5_c3_b: "Anytime. Fair warning, though—once Artoria is lying on the table, coaching us from behind the sterile drape is strictly against the rules."
choices.choice_ar5_c3_c: "Deal. Whenever you want to rest for once, the team and I will trade places at the side of the table and catch you steady."

nodes.ar5_s1_01: Bright morning sunlight streamed past the glass windows of the surgical doctors' office, where the imaging films and instrument configuration sheets for tomorrow's open biliary reconstruction lay neatly arrayed across the long table.
nodes.ar5_s1_02: Moe Honjo and Anji Tonegawa stood side by side along one edge of the table, each cradling a practice notebook bristling with color-coded index tabs, their expressions earnest yet brimming with unmistakable nervous anticipation.
nodes.ar5_s1_03: "Dr. Artoria, Dr. Sakaguchi, Hiroko-senpai! Here are my review notes on pre-case instrument setup for our recent open hepatobiliary procedures—I even redrew diagrams for the passing angles of the long atraumatic biliary clamps and fine needle holders. Please have a look!"
nodes.ar5_s1_04: "And I've compiled this quarter's perioperative checklists for major abdominal cases, specialty suture usage logs, and instrument handoff timelines in full. Whichever sterile workflow you want to quiz me on, I'm ready to answer on the spot!"
nodes.ar5_s1_05: "Thank you both for your hard work. Every single page is extraordinarily thorough—anyone can tell at a glance this isn't something thrown together overnight."
nodes.ar5_s1_06: "Well... this is the OR department's sole slot this quarter for the 'Specialty Mentorship in Complex Abdominal Scrub Nursing,' after all. Who wouldn't want to scrub in on major tables alongside Hiroko-senpai and both of you?"
nodes.ar5_s1_07: "M-me too! When I first started in the OR I was all thumbs and so much slower than Anji, so lately I've stayed after shift every day practicing blind instrument passes at an empty Mayo stand—and Ms. Irisviel's operation last time drove home even deeper how much instrument-side coordination matters... This time, I really don't want to just watch from the periphery anymore!"
nodes.ar5_s1_08: Artoria gave the two young nurses a warm nod; only after Moe and Anji bowed, excused themselves to verify morning supplies at the nurses' station, and pulled the office door softly shut did the easy smile on her face gradually subside.
nodes.ar5_s1_09: Across the long table, senior scrub nurse Hiroko Sugimura opened the mentorship evaluation folder in her hands and slid it seriously in front of Artoria and Ryuji Sakaguchi.
nodes.ar5_s1_10: "Dr. Artoria, Dr. Sakaguchi. Operating room policy leaves zero wiggle room here—to safeguard sterile safety and mentorship quality in complex open cases, I am only permitted to supervise and sign off on one junior nurse one-on-one for the entire quarter. We cannot split the slot in half, nor can we have them alternate cases."
nodes.ar5_s1_11: "Hiroko, as the senior scrub nurse overseeing the training firsthand, how do you assess the two of them?"
nodes.ar5_s1_12: "Honestly, both young women cleared the bar, and whichever one isn't chosen will break my heart a little. Strictly from a professional standpoint, though, their trajectories point in different directions—"
nodes.ar5_s1_13: Hiroko rested a fingertip on the notebook to the left, its pages covered in hand-drawn instrument sketches:
nodes.ar5_s1_14: "Moe did start from a weaker foundation and used to hesitate whenever she felt rushed. Over this recent stretch on circulating duty, however, she memorized every open-abdominal instrument sequence cold, and the hours of targeted drills she's logged are completely real. Her aim right now is singular—stepping across from circulating nurse to the primary scrub table—which dovetails directly with the routine open-surgery scrub bench our OR needs most urgently."
nodes.ar5_s1_15: Next, Hiroko tapped the crisp data tables and workflow charts in the folder on the right:
nodes.ar5_s1_16: "Anji, by contrast, is a natural honor student—quick-thinking and wide-ranging in vision. Ever since she learned last time to share risks proactively with her partner, her sharpness in pre-op preparation, cross-department blood-bank coordination, and full-cycle perioperative verification has grown steadier than even some third-year nurses'. Yet her application for this scrub mentorship slot is every bit as compliant with the rules."
nodes.ar5_s1_17: "My clinical assessment is written right here. As for who receives this single seat, the Deputy Chief and Dr. Sakaguchi will need to make the final call today."
nodes.ar5_s1_18: Gathering the remaining shift schedules off the table, Hiroko inclined her head politely and left the office to inspect the operating rooms.
nodes.ar5_s1_20: Artoria looked down at the two notebooks of nearly identical thickness on the table, deep thought rising in her emerald eyes.
nodes.ar5_s1_21: Stepping over to the table, Ryuji Sakaguchi immediately recalled the hypothetical question the two of them had talked over across Artoria's breakfast table a few mornings ago—
nodes.ar5_s1_22: When two young people have both prepared thoroughly and poured everything they have into earning a chance, yet there truly is only one seat, how should a leader face the disappointment that is bound to follow?
nodes.ar5_s1_23: Back then, that hypothetical had lingered harmlessly in the scent of slightly burnt toast; today, it wore Moe's and Anji's expectant faces.
nodes.ar5_s2_01: Back inside the Deputy Chief's office with the door shut and no one else present, Artoria set the two application forms side by side on her desk, her fingers resting lightly atop Moe's sheet.
nodes.ar5_s2_02: "...Sakaguchi-kun. When we spoke about this over breakfast at home a few days ago, I hadn't expected the day itself to arrive quite so soon."
nodes.ar5_s2_03: "Moe stayed behind in the instrument room after hours drilling clamp passes, and Anji reorganized every perioperative ledger from the past stretch from top to bottom. Neither of them cut a single corner—in fact, both put what you taught them in that last operation straight into practice. Where do you stand on the choice?"
nodes.ar5_s2_04: "Judging by the training objective and Hiroko's evaluation, I agree that Moe is the right fit for this slot."
nodes.ar5_s2_05: Her voice was clear and assured, without a trace of hesitation over the evaluation standard itself:
nodes.ar5_s2_06: "Our operating room's most urgent gap right now is the routine open primary-scrub bench, and Moe's sustained drills have been aimed squarely at that post; Anji's greatest strength lies in cross-stage verification and big-picture coordination. Assigning this seat to Moe by transparent role fit—I have no doubt about that conclusion itself."
nodes.ar5_s2_07: Watching the slight crease between her brows, Ryuji Sakaguchi asked gently:
nodes.ar5_s2_08: "Then what made your pen pause is Anji?"
nodes.ar5_s2_09: "Yes. What truly gives me pause is the timing of the announcement."
nodes.ar5_s2_10: Lifting her gaze to tomorrow's operative schedule at the corner of her desk, she spoke earnestly:
nodes.ar5_s2_11: "First thing tomorrow morning is Ms. Aoi Tohsaka's open biliary reconstruction—dense local adhesions, high anatomical risk, zero margin for error inside or outside the sterile field. Anji has always held herself to fierce standards and prepared so thoroughly for this selection—I worry that announcing she wasn't chosen the day before a major operation will saddle her with sudden emotional strain. I don't want her walking into tomorrow's OR carrying fresh disappointment."
nodes.ar5_s2_12: "So I was wondering whether we ought to sign off on the selection privately today and hold the announcement until tomorrow's major operation is safely behind us."
nodes.ar5_s2_13: Sakaguchi listened quietly until she finished laying out her concern, then gave a thoughtful nod:
nodes.ar5_s2_14: "That concern makes complete sense. Protecting a team member's state of mind before a major case is exactly what a lead surgeon and team leader ought to consider."
nodes.ar5_s2_15: "Still, I worry about the flip-side risk—they just turned in their notebooks this morning, and both know perfectly well the decision is being finalized today. If we say nothing all day, the two of them will end up wondering about the verdict during every lull in tomorrow's operation instead."
nodes.ar5_s2_16: "And knowing Anji's perceptiveness and pride, if she finds out after surgery that we had already signed the decision today and held it back out of fear she might lose her composure, that would probably sting far worse than simply losing the slot—because it would make her feel we didn't trust her professionalism."
nodes.ar5_s2_17: Artoria blinked faintly, lowered her lashes in thought for two seconds, and let out a candid soft sigh as clear resolve returned to her eyes:
nodes.ar5_s2_18: "...You're right. Stepping into the OR left hanging in guesswork—or feeling afterward that she wasn't treated as a mature professional nurse—would place a far heavier burden on both of them."
nodes.ar5_s2_19: Picking up the fountain pen on her desk without further hesitation, she wrote Moe Honjo's name and her own Deputy Chief signature neatly in the approval box, then passed the pen to Sakaguchi for his co-signature.
nodes.ar5_s2_20: "Then let's tell them right now—and explain our reasoning together, clearly and in full."
nodes.ar5_c1a_01: "When we meet them in a moment, let me open by walking through the selection criteria and bench gap thoroughly. If Anji struggles to swallow it right away and wants to press for answers face-to-face, it'll be easier for her to aim those questions straight at me."
nodes.ar5_c1a_02: Artoria shook her head gently, a warm yet unwavering smile touching her lips:
nodes.ar5_c1a_03: "Both of our signatures are on that page, Sakaguchi-kun. Delivering the decision is my duty as Deputy Chief—and as for the disappointment and questions that follow, the two of us will catch them together."
nodes.ar5_c1b_01: "Agreed. Today let's lay out plainly why Moe was selected and where tomorrow's surgical safety boundaries stand; as for Anji's next-step track, let's place a concrete, fully worked-out plan in her hands once tomorrow's operation is safely done, so it doesn't sound like hollow consolation today."
nodes.ar5_c1b_02: Artoria inclined her head in approval:
nodes.ar5_c1b_03: "My thoughts exactly. First respect the time she needs to absorb the disappointment, then answer for her growth with a concrete, actionable plan."
nodes.ar5_c1c_01: "Agreed. Making a call that can't leave everyone happy is only the first half of the job—both today's candid explanation and our sustained mentorship for the one not chosen afterward, we see all the way through together."
nodes.ar5_c1c_02: Meeting Sakaguchi's steady, forthright gaze, Artoria let a warm smile soften her brow:
nodes.ar5_c1c_03: "Yes. With you standing beside me, Sakaguchi-kun, even the hardest words can be spoken squarely and without flinching."
nodes.ar5_s2m_01: Gathering the co-signed evaluation folder, the two of them stepped out of the Deputy Chief's office side by side and headed for the consultation room beside the surgical nurses' station.
nodes.ar5_s2_2_01: Ten minutes later, Moe Honjo and Anji Tonegawa stood inside the consultation room with Hiroko Sugimura attending alongside them.
nodes.ar5_s2_2_02: "For this quarter's one-on-one Specialty Mentorship in Complex Abdominal Scrub Nursing under Nurse Hiroko's supervision—following Nurse Hiroko's clinical evaluation and joint deliberation between Dr. Sakaguchi and myself—we have selected Moe Honjo."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_03: Moe's eyes flew wide; both hands clapped reflexively over her lips as her rims turned red on the spot:
nodes.ar5_s2_2_05: Beside her, Anji Tonegawa visibly stiffened. Dropping her gaze swiftly to the tips of her shoes, she curled her fingers quietly into the hem of her uniform skirt before forcing her head back up two seconds later and speaking in a carefully polite voice:
nodes.ar5_s2_2_06: "...Congratulations, Moe. Staying behind in the instrument room every evening after shift—you really earned it."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_07: "Anji... um, truthfully Anji's theory notes and checklists were done so much better than mine..."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_08: "Moe, there's no need to apologize for a result you earned through honest work; and Anji, you don't need to force yourself to smile right away and pretend it doesn't sting."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_09: Looking straight at Anji—visibly downcast yet holding her composure together through sheer poise—Ryuji Sakaguchi spoke in a clear, measured voice:
nodes.ar5_s2_2_10: "Assigning this slot to Moe isn't because your effort fell short. It's because this quarter's mentorship targets a single specific staffing gap—primary scrub passing for routine and complex open laparotomies—and Moe's sustained drills map directly onto that seat. If you have any questions whatsoever about the criteria, whether today or after tomorrow's operation wraps up, come press me on them anytime. I'm accountable to you for this call."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_11: "Anji, Dr. Sakaguchi, Nurse Hiroko, and I have all seen your command of cross-stage risk verification and full-cycle perioperative coordination firsthand. I won't insult you today with vague platitudes—once Ms. Aoi Tohsaka's operation is behind us tomorrow, let's sit down separately and map out your real next-stage development plan point by point, alright?"
nodes.ar5_s2_2_12: Anji bit her lower lip, a flash of genuine frustration crossing her eyes—yet meeting the two surgeons' candid, unvarnished gaze, she drew a deep breath and squared her spine:
nodes.ar5_s2_2_13: "...Understood, Dr. Artoria, Dr. Sakaguchi. We're on duty right now, and I won't let personal feelings affect tomorrow's surgical preparations."
nodes.ar5_s2_2_14: "Good. One further principle must be stated upfront—earning a future specialty training slot does not mean skipping ranks to solo a high-risk primary scrub table tomorrow. Ms. Aoi Tohsaka's open biliary reconstruction carries complex anatomy, so Hiroko Sugimura remains primary scrub nurse; Moe will handle in-room circulating and head-side monitoring while assisting pre-case setup under Hiroko's supervision; Anji will oversee perioperative blood-bank, specialty suture, and peripheral cross-stage coordination. Patient safety comes first, always. Understood?"
nodes.ar5_s3_1_01: Early the next morning, soft daylight filled the private surgical ward room.
nodes.ar5_s3_1_02: Adult female patient Aoi Tohsaka sat resting quietly against the head of her bed. With smooth, long dark-brown hair and a gentle, composed demeanor, she inclined her head politely as Artoria and Ryuji Sakaguchi stepped inside for their final preoperative check.
nodes.ar5_s3_1_04: "Good morning, Ms. Tohsaka. Were you able to sleep alright last night? Any chills or worsening fullness in your right upper abdomen?"
nodes.ar5_s3_1_05: "Thanks to all of you, I slept very peacefully. After going through two endoscopic stent dilations at another hospital only to have it clog and trigger fevers again within months each time, I'll admit a heavy stone had been sitting on my chest... Hearing the two of you explain the logic behind open reconstruction so clearly finally let me set my mind at ease."
nodes.ar5_s3_1_06: "Because your biliary stricture sits relatively high and the local scar tissue keeps recoiling, endoscopic stenting alone can't maintain lasting patency anymore. Today we'll trim that narrowed segment cleanly back to healthy tissue and bring up a loop of jejunum for a tension-free hepaticojejunostomy, resolving bile drainage at the root."
nodes.ar5_s3_1_07: "Those two young nurses—Ms. Honjo and Ms. Tonegawa—stopped by bright and early to verify my skin prep, urinary catheter, and pre-op medications. Both of them were wonderfully gentle and attentive, and even their handoff as they walked me through the precautions ran like clockwork."
nodes.ar5_s3_1_08: Smiling warmly, Aoi Tohsaka looked toward Artoria with tranquil eyes:
nodes.ar5_s3_1_09: "Anyone can see what a fine team you've nurtured, Dr. Artoria. On the operating table today, I'll place myself in your hands with complete peace of mind."
nodes.ar5_s3_1_10: "Thank you for your trust, Ms. Tohsaka. We will bring you safely back to this room without fail."
nodes.ar5_s3_2_01: Half an hour later, the shadowless lamps flared on inside fourth-floor Operating Room One.
nodes.ar5_s3_2_02: Before incision, lead surgeon Artoria personally placed a high thoracic epidural catheter with Aoi Tohsaka cooperating in the lateral decubitus position, carefully verifying that the sensory block covered both the upper abdominal incision zone and visceral traction planes before supplementing with light intravenous sedation.
nodes.ar5_s3_2_03: Returned to the supine position, Aoi Tohsaka underwent final sterile verification, broad povidone-iodine prep from abdomen to perineum, and layered green sterile draping under Moe and Hiroko's disciplined teamwork. Fresh from standard surgical scrub, Artoria and Ryuji Sakaguchi donned long-sleeved sterile gowns and double sterile gloves, taking their places as lead surgeon and first assistant.
nodes.ar5_s3_2_04: (Reporting clearly from the verification station linking the OR to the prep bay) "Peripheral coordination check complete—patient Aoi Tohsaka, Bismuth Type II benign common hepatic duct stricture scheduled for open Roux-en-Y hepaticojejunostomy. Four units cross-matched blood ready in the OR blood-bank refrigerator, warmed saline irrigation holding at 37 degrees, dual backup sets of 5-0 and 6-0 fine monofilament absorbable biliary sutures verified and standing by!"
nodes.ar5_s3_2_05: (Reporting beside the head-side monitor) "High thoracic epidural block level stable, patient awake and calm—blood pressure 116/72, heart rate 68, oxygen saturation 99%, indwelling urinary catheter draining clear!"
nodes.ar5_s3_2_06: Crisp, seamless two-person callouts without an ounce of hesitation—and without the faintest trace of friction carried over from yesterday's mentorship selection.
nodes.ar5_s3_2_07: From the lead surgeon's spot, Artoria swept a gaze calm as still water across the room above her surgical mask:
nodes.ar5_s3_2_08: "Very good. Before skin incision, let me restate our core protective priorities one final time—this patient's hepatoduodenal ligament has weathered recurrent cholangitis and two prior endoscopic interventions, so local fibrosis may run denser than imaging suggests. Everything today hinges first on guarding the portal vein and hepatic arterial branches rigorously, and second on guaranteeing our hepaticojejunostomy rich mucosal perfusion, zero tension, and zero bile leak."
nodes.ar5_s3_2_09: "Hiroko has primary instrument passing, Dr. Sakaguchi works deep exposure with me, and Moe and Anji keep fluid balance and specialty supplies synchronized at all times. If anyone spots the slightest anomaly from your post, don't hesitate—speak up immediately."
nodes.ar5_s3_2_11: From behind the sterile ether screen at the head of the table came Aoi Tohsaka's gentle, unhurried voice:
nodes.ar5_s3_2_12: "I'm in your hands, doctors and nurses."
nodes.ar5_s3_2_13: Inclining her head toward the head of the table, Artoria turned back to the operative field, her eyes sharpening in an instant to a focused blade as she extended her right hand level toward the Mayo stand:
nodes.ar5_s4_01: Ninety minutes into the operation, everything had progressed on an even keel.
nodes.ar5_s4_02: Crisp beams from the shadowless lamps converged deep in the right upper quadrant. With rock-steady wrists, Artoria alternated fine electrocautery and long Metzenbaum scissors, freeing the hepatic flexure of the transverse colon and the first part of the duodenum millimeter by millimeter along the outer rim of dense grayish-white scar left by repeated cholangitis.
nodes.ar5_s4_03: Behind the head-side drape, Aoi Tohsaka breathed evenly; shielded by the high thoracic epidural block she felt no sharp pain, only shifting a fingertip lightly now and then at deep traction.
nodes.ar5_s4_04: (Murmuring reassurance at the head of the table while calling vitals) "Ms. Tohsaka, we're separating the old scar tissue around your bile duct right now—if you feel mild pressure in your upper abdomen or want to take a deep breath, tell me anytime. —Dr. Artoria, epidural block remains steady at T4, blood pressure 112/70, heart rate 66, net blood loss by suction canister plus sponge weight approximately 85 milliliters."
nodes.ar5_s4_05: (Softly) "Mm... it doesn't hurt at all, Ms. Honjo. Please go right ahead."
nodes.ar5_s4_06: "Copy that, keep holding steady. Dr. Sakaguchi, slip the deep S-retractor under the inferior margin of the quadrate lobe and lift gently cephalad—mind your pressure, the anterior wall of the portal vein sits directly behind this fibrous plate."
nodes.ar5_s4_07: "Understood. Field is open—Hiroko, fine right-angle dissecting clamp for the lead."
nodes.ar5_s4_08: "Right-angle clamp. Warm saline peanut sponges standing by."
nodes.ar5_s4_09: Yet as Artoria carefully incised the anterior wall of the Bismuth Type II stricture and suctioned away stagnant concentrated bile, their smooth momentum paused half a beat just beneath the hepatic hilum.
nodes.ar5_s4_10: Exposed under the operating lights, the proximal common hepatic duct stump did not reveal supple, rosy healthy mucosa at the planned level—recurrent cholangitis and tissue reaction from two prior stents had lined the lumen at the intended anastomotic plane with circumferential fibrous hyperplasia, leaving the usable cuff of healthy duct nearly a full centimeter shorter than projected and rendering the chronically edematous wall fragile and thin.
nodes.ar5_s4_11: For two seconds, complete stillness fell around the table.
nodes.ar5_s4_12: Rather than pressing blindly higher into the hilum, Artoria deliberately stayed her scissors and sheltered the field beneath warm saline gauze:
nodes.ar5_s4_13: "Hold forward dissection—everyone pause while we reassess local anatomy."
nodes.ar5_s4_14: (Inspecting the margin closely) "Mucosal scarring at the planned common hepatic duct plane runs too deep—forcing a direct anastomosis here risks recurrent stricture or bile leak, yet skeletonizing straight up the main trunk into the hilum could easily strip the 3- and 9-o'clock axial epicholedochal arterial plexus, and an ischemic stump won't heal either."
nodes.ar5_s4_15: Without waiting for the lead surgeon to call their names, the two junior nurses inside and outside the sterile field executed a brisk information relay—
nodes.ar5_s4_16: "Reporting to lead! Hemodynamics and oxygenation remain rock-solid, and we have ample epidural top-up margin—the patient can comfortably tolerate the additional fine operating time needed for proximal ductoplasty!"
nodes.ar5_s4_17: (Holding up the verified sterile outer pack at the pass-through counter in tandem) "Dr. Artoria, Hiroko-senpai—our backup double-armed 6-0 monofilament absorbable atraumatic sutures with fine micro-taper needles are verified and ready to peel-pack onto the field right now! Fresh 37-degree irrigation bag is up as well!"
nodes.ar5_s4_18: Not a flicker of panic, and not one person needing to be reminded to speak up anymore. Standing squarely within their own posts, every member of the room had already placed the exact puzzle pieces the lead surgeon needed onto the table.
nodes.ar5_c2a_01: "Dr. Artoria, look just beneath the hilar plate—the transverse segment of the left hepatic duct runs crystal clear, and its anterior serosal surface is smooth and untouched by the ring scar below. Instead of stripping upward, spatulating longitudinally along the anterior wall of the left hepatic duct should let us sidestep the lateral axial blood supply altogether."
nodes.ar5_c2a_02: Above her surgical mask, Artoria's eyes lit up faintly, exchanging a wordless look of pure surgical kinship with Sakaguchi:
nodes.ar5_c2b_01: "I've palpated the right hepatic artery pulse posterolateral to the hilum and have it shielded safely behind my narrow-blade retractor alongside the portal bifurcation. Your right-hand vascular boundary is secure—you have a clear lane to extend the stoma along the anterior wall of the left hepatic duct."
nodes.ar5_c2b_02: Seeing Sakaguchi's millimeter-true retraction angle, Artoria gave a steady nod:
nodes.ar5_c2b_03: "That helps immensely, Dr. Sakaguchi. The exposure couldn't be clearer."
nodes.ar5_s4m_01: Artoria made the call decisively, her voice ringing clear and assured:
nodes.ar5_s4m_02: "Revising anastomotic strategy—we will not skeletonize periductal tissue blindly into the hilum, preserving the 3- and 9-o'clock axial arterial supply to the fullest; instead, we spatulate longitudinally about 1.2 centimeters along the healthy anterior wall of the left hepatic duct for proximal ductoplasty, creating a wide stoma for a mucosa-to-mucosa anastomosis to our tension-free Roux-en-Y jejunal limb!"
nodes.ar5_s4m_03: "Hiroko, fine Potts biliary scissors, followed by 6-0 atraumatic suture."
nodes.ar5_s4m_04: "Copy. Potts scissors—Anji, open the first 6-0 set."
nodes.ar5_s4m_06: The forty minutes that followed held the entire operating room in breathless focus.
nodes.ar5_s4m_07: Backed by Sakaguchi's rock-steady deep retraction and pinpoint suction, Artoria guided the slender Potts scissors cleanly up the anterior wall of the left hepatic duct. Clear pale-gold bile welled forth at once, revealing supple, well-perfused rosy biliary mucosa inside.
nodes.ar5_s4m_08: Next, she took the micro-needle holder from Hiroko Sugimura.
nodes.ar5_s4m_09: Hair-fine 6-0 monofilament could tear a fragile edematous duct rim at the slightest tug inside so deep and narrow a hilar field. Yet every bite, exit, and throw from Artoria's hand moved with textbook cadence—catching full-thickness jejunal wall to healthy hepatic-duct mucosa with unerring precision while metering knot tension delicately enough never to blanch the microvascular rim.
nodes.ar5_s4m_10: Posterior-row stay placement, interrupted anterior precision knots... As the final corner stitch settled snugly home, the once-strictured hilar biliary tree stood reconstructed into a broad, flat, utterly tension-free hepaticojejunal conduit.
nodes.ar5_s4m_11: "Anastomosis complete. Warm saline irrigation, then gentle dry-sponge blot check."
nodes.ar5_s4m_12: Sakaguchi irrigated the field thoroughly with warm saline and touched clean peanut sponges around every aspect of the suture line—bone-dry and pristine, without a drop of ooze or bile staining.
nodes.ar5_s4m_13: "Anastomotic rim is pink and well perfused, mesenteric defect closed—zero tension, zero bile leak."
nodes.ar5_s4m_14: "Instruments, needles, and sponges—all three counts match completely!"
nodes.ar5_s4m_15: Letting out a quiet breath at last, Artoria turned toward the sterile drape at the head of the table, her voice softening back into reassuring warmth:
nodes.ar5_s4m_16: "Ms. Tohsaka, the critical biliary reconstruction is finished, and it went wonderfully. We'll place a surgical drain and close your abdominal wall layer by layer now—you'll be back in your room resting very soon."
nodes.ar5_s4m_17: Behind the drape, moisture glistened faintly at the corner of Aoi Tohsaka's eye as she breathed a soft sigh of relief, her voice quiet yet deeply sincere:
nodes.ar5_s4m_18: "Thank you, Dr. Artoria... and thank you as well, Dr. Sakaguchi and every one of the nurses. Listening to your calm, orderly voices around the table, I truly wasn't frightened for a single moment."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_01: By three in the afternoon, Aoi Tohsaka's vital signs and abdominal drain output back on the surgical ward had been confirmed completely stable.
nodes.ar5_s5_1_02: Having completed every postoperative order handoff, Ryuji Sakaguchi and Artoria returned to the outer supply room of the surgical suite to find Anji Tonegawa standing alone at the ledger desk, logging the lot numbers of today's opened 6-0 fine sutures stroke by stroke.
nodes.ar5_s5_1_03: Hearing footsteps, Anji paused her pen and turned around. With the taut adrenaline of the operation behind her, the fiercely proud young nurse could no longer quite hide the quiet dejection on her face.
nodes.ar5_s5_1_04: "Dr. Artoria, Dr. Sakaguchi. I've finished filing Ms. Tohsaka's unused blood-bank return slip and closed-loop specialty supply records."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_05: "Having dual backup sets of 6-0 atraumatic sutures pre-staged in the outer bay saved us priceless transition time at the table today. You did outstanding work, Anji."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_06: Clasping her folder against her chest with both hands, Anji fell silent for two seconds before lifting her eyes to Sakaguchi and Artoria, the rims of her eyes faintly red yet her tone candid and earnest:
nodes.ar5_s5_1_07: "...Yesterday Dr. Sakaguchi said that if anything still felt hard to swallow, I could ask face-to-face once the operation was over. May I... ask one thing right now?"
nodes.ar5_s5_1_09: "Watching through the pass-through window today as Hiroko-senpai handed you the Potts scissors and micro-needle holder, and watching Moe call monitor vitals inside the room... truthfully, it still hurt a little inside."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_10: Drawing a deep breath, she made no attempt to disguise either the pride or the disappointment of a standout newcomer:
nodes.ar5_s5_1_11: "I don't think Moe fell short in the slightest—she was rock-steady in there. Yet I still couldn't stop thinking... I memorized all those hepatobiliary instrument sequences too. If I had been the one given this quarter's one-on-one mentorship seat, I wouldn't have let anyone down either, would I?"
nodes.ar5_s5_1_12: Sakaguchi neither looked away nor brushed her off with platitudes like 'you're young, plenty of chances will come later':
nodes.ar5_s5_1_13: "Yes—had you been chosen, with your sharp mind and execution, you would have excelled at it too. Neither Dr. Artoria nor I ever doubted that for a second."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_14: "Even so, the OR truly has only one primary-scrub mentorship seat this quarter—and right now our sharpest shortage is dedicated hands for routine open scrub tables, while cross-stage verification for high-risk perioperative cases likewise cannot be left without someone strong at the helm. Awarding the sole seat to Moe, who has focused relentlessly on primary scrub drills, was a trade-off the Deputy Chief and I co-signed together. That you had to shoulder this disappointment today rests on our decision, not on any lack of excellence in you."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_15: Stepping forward, Artoria placed a training folder written out cleanly in her own hand into Anji's grasp, her voice warm yet solemn:
nodes.ar5_s5_1_16: "Anji, this isn't a 'consolation prize' cobbled together to cheer you up—we cannot conjure a second one-on-one primary scrub slot out of thin air, and we owe you complete honesty on that."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_17: "Starting next month, however, Surgery and the OR department are formally establishing our 'Standard Protocol for Complex Open Perioperative Risk Verification & Critical Handoff.' Dr. Sakaguchi and I have officially nominated you to Head Nurse Ishigami as nursing lead coordinator, with the two of us mentoring you directly through anatomical risk mapping and supply logic for complex cases—and when the next quarterly primary-scrub rotation opens, you remain completely free to compete on the exact same transparent footing."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_18: Looking down as she opened the neatly handwritten plan—every weekly case-review milestone already mapped out in crisp detail—Anji bit her lip, the tip of her nose stinging.
nodes.ar5_s5_1_19: She didn't burst into an instant grin or claim every ounce of disappointment had vanished; instead, she brushed the corner of one eye lightly with her thumb and spoke in a quiet, honest voice:
nodes.ar5_s5_1_20: "...Saying I don't envy Moe at all would definitely be a lie, and I'll probably still mope a little when I get home tonight."
nodes.ar5_s5_1_21: Lifting her head again, her eyes shone clear and upright once more:
nodes.ar5_s5_1_22: "Still—thank you both for spelling everything out to me without holding back a thing, Dr. Sakaguchi, Dr. Artoria. Next month's perioperative risk-verification protocol—I'll build the finest standard in this entire hospital!"
nodes.ar5_s5_1_23: Watching Anji square her shoulders and stride out of the supply room cradling the folder against her chest, even the air down the corridor seemed to lighten.
nodes.ar5_s5_2_01: Back inside the Deputy Chief's office with the door eased shut behind them, only the two of them remained.
nodes.ar5_s5_2_02: Standing by the window, Artoria brewed two cups of warm black tea herself and handed one to Ryuji Sakaguchi. With no outsiders present, the Deputy Chief's taut poise melted naturally from her brow, leaving quiet warmth in her eyes as she looked at him.
nodes.ar5_s5_2_03: "What's that look for? Still feeling a pang over Anji's red-rimmed eyes just now?"
nodes.ar5_s5_2_04: "A little, of course. Even more than that, though... I feel reassured, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_05: Cradling her teacup, she gazed past the windowpane toward the distant hospital grounds as if recalling days from long ago, her voice soft as a passing breeze:
nodes.ar5_s5_2_06: "A teacher who mentored me once told me something—'Making the call, and caring for those left behind after the call is made, were never two separate duties to begin with.' When I was younger and focused solely on honing my blade, I naively believed that if I simply worked a little harder and shouldered a little more on everyone's behalf, no one around me would ever have to taste disappointment."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_07: Drawing her gaze back from the window, she turned toward Ryuji Sakaguchi beside her, her emerald eyes clear and unclouded:
nodes.ar5_s5_2_08: "Only over these past two days—facing a knot where someone was bound to feel let down whichever way we chose, and watching you neither shy away from signing the call nor hesitate to step out front and catch Anji's frustration squarely—did I realize someone beside me was already carrying that hardest duty so remarkably well."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_09: "That only worked because you've noticed and remembered every ounce of effort Moe and Anji put in day after day—that's why every word of your plan rang true to them today. Me lecturing on standards with a straight face alone would never have brought out the teamwork we saw in that OR."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_10: Artoria gave a gentle shake of her head, a tranquil smile—free of the slightest strain or bitterness—gracing her lips:
nodes.ar5_s5_2_11: "I know well what my strengths are, Sakaguchi-kun. Standing beneath the shadowless lamps with a scalpel in hand, or tending the soil in which everyone on our team grows—that is a pride I will never yield under any circumstance."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_12: Pausing briefly, she spoke in a natural, unhurried tone, as though sharing a discovery that brought quiet gladness even to herself after long reflection:
nodes.ar5_s5_2_13: "Watching your back today, though, I suddenly found myself thinking about 'my place'... Whether it's Dr. Mido's unstoppable decisiveness out front or the breadth of command and accountability you showed today, it occurred to me that when it comes to leading the entire surgical department even further ahead, perhaps there truly is someone better suited than I am to stand in that foremost seat."
nodes.ar5_s5_2_14: "...Artoria, don't tell me you're trying to bow out politely on my account?"
nodes.ar5_s5_2_15: (Shaking her head with a soft laugh) "As if I ever would. So long as I serve a single day as Deputy Chief of Surgery, I won't slacken by a fraction on any duty or evaluation that belongs to this post. I'm simply... very glad to walk alongside a peer like you."
nodes.ar5_s6_01: Toward evening, briefcases packed for the day, the two of them walked side by side down the long corridor outside the fourth-floor surgical suite on their way off shift.
nodes.ar5_s6_02: At the far end of the hall, soft overhead lights still glowed inside vacant Operating Room Three.
nodes.ar5_s6_03: Looking in through the wide double-paned glass observation window—Hiroko Sugimura stood beside a Mayo stand, patiently coaching Moe Honjo through the fine needle-holder and right-angle clamp angles from today's biliary reconstruction while Moe nodded earnestly and jotted rapid notes in her pad.
nodes.ar5_s6_04: Just then, the inner door eased open and Anji Tonegawa stepped in carrying tomorrow's elective perioperative checklist folder, naturally handing the verified suture sheet over to Hiroko and Moe; heads together, the three of them murmured over tomorrow morning's setup details, trading easy quiet laughs and replies while anesthesia and nursing colleagues in the prep bay beyond wrapped up their evening handoff in smooth order.
nodes.ar5_s6_05: Without meaning to, Artoria slowed to a stop.
nodes.ar5_s6_06: Warm corridor light rested quietly across the tips of her golden hair and her softened profile. Watching the team beyond the glass—seasoned and young looking out for one another, still standing shoulder to shoulder for the next patient even after navigating hard choices and honest disappointment—deep trust and warmth rippled across her eyes.
nodes.ar5_s6_07: After a long moment, she turned her head slightly toward Ryuji Sakaguchi beside her; with the tenderness of someone setting down a thousand-pound burden mingled with a touch of playful mischief that amused even herself, she spoke softly:
nodes.ar5_s6_08: "...Perhaps next time, I ought to try it myself. Not standing beside the operating table, but lying upon it—and letting this remarkable team of ours take good care of me for once."
nodes.ar5_c3a_01: "If the Deputy Chief herself actually lay down on that operating table, Hiroko might take it in stride, but Moe and Anji would be so nervous they'd recite the checklist a hundred times starting three days out."
nodes.ar5_c3a_02: (Unable to hold back a quiet laugh behind her hand) "Well, we couldn't have that—if I cost them sleep, wouldn't that count as another dereliction of duty on my part? Still... with the nurses they've become now, I think I could close my eyes and sleep very soundly indeed."
nodes.ar5_c3b_01: "You're welcome anytime. Fair warning upfront, though—once Artoria is actually lying on that operating table, coaching me on knot tension from behind the sterile drape is strictly forbidden."
nodes.ar5_c3b_02: (Cheeks warming faintly as she shot him an amused, lightly reproachful glance) "Just how incapable of letting go of work am I in your eyes, Sakaguchi-kun... Once I decide to place myself in your hands and the team's, I promise I'll be an obedient patient that day."
nodes.ar5_c3c_01: "Deal. Up until now you've always been the one standing beside the table shielding everyone else from the wind and rain—whenever you feel like trading places and resting for once, the team and I will stand beside the table and catch you steady."
nodes.ar5_c3c_02: Artoria blinked for an instant before her lips curved into an unguarded, radiant smile that belonged to Artoria alone:
nodes.ar5_c3c_03: "Mm... With your word on that, Sakaguchi-kun, I'll hold it close to heart."
nodes.ar5_s6m_01: Beyond the observation window, the lights shone on—bright, steady, and warm.
nodes.ar5_s6m_02: Out in the corridor, Artoria and Ryuji Sakaguchi shared a quiet smile; their fingers brushed naturally for the briefest instant beside the hems of their white coats before they turned side by side and walked down the hushed hall toward the evening beyond the hospital doors.
